name: PowOS warm CDP runner (Mac)
purpose: powos-cdp-warm-<user>: one long-lived oven/bun container in powos-vadb's network that tools/phone/cdp.sh docker-execs cdp.ts in (phone WebView evals for checks and agents), instead of a fresh docker run per call. Recreated when powos-vadb's container changes; ends itself (and --rm removes it) after 15 min with no call (CDP_WARM_IDLE_S). cdp.sh falls back to the per-call docker run when it can't start; CDP_WARM=0 forces that path.
